verdict.rationale: Vendor marketing describes natural-language audience description with mParticle 'suggesting logic' and predictive scoring (churn/growth likelihood), which are AI-generated insight/suggestion features, but these are only brief marketing blurbs with no technical docs, screenshots, or independent hands-on corroboration of an actual in-product AI assistant. missing for 10: detailed product documentation of the AI feature, independent/hands-on verification, breadth of insight types beyond audience suggestions and churn scoring.
